objective: Add original Solar Legion/Nebula Legion four-class, three-lane Genesis Empire Arena minion waves with self-contained deterministic AI, in-app lightweight animated visual silhouettes, event-time hits and restrained cues. Preserve trained RTS units, BUKLOD characters, standalone solo duel, account economy, ranked authority and production untouched. Follow-up: frame-interpolated identity-accurate locomotion, facing, dynamic weapon swing, defensive/kiting/support AI formation and viewport-culling for native performance.
productionBaselineEvidence: Based on live GitHub integration/genesis-all-updates-conso-staging-20261122 head d3b618f, branch PR #1074; no exact Google Play production source/build/runtime verification in this workstream and no production writes. DEV-only isolation.
chosenApproach: Make separate match-local minions array+strict optional enableMinionWaves contract in the existing canonical offline Arena engine, read-only local artwork via SVG and wave state; keep villager/army command, bot training, wallet and ranked client unchanged.
selectionRationale: User requested minion imagery and actual game behavior. Existing arena had only manually trained villagers/soldiers and no minion waves. Opt-in deterministic lane AI integrates with real heroes/towers and avoids rearchitecting the BUKLOD MAIN in-app Arena or falsely granting progression.

preservedBehaviors: Existing BUKLOD MAIN app navigation, AdMob, route access, auth, session, audio focus, other dashboards and offline team controls remain unchanged; solo duel has no waves.
